meta.name: dan-kennedy-copy
meta.description: Write copy that sells NOW using Dan Kennedy's "No B.S." direct response marketing principles Use when: **Writing sales copy** that must generate immediate, trackable response; **Creating direct mail pieces**, sales letters, or landing pages for local businesses; **Designing marketing funnels** with clear offers at every stage; **Breaking free from "brand advertising"** that doesn't produce measurable ROI; **Building follow-up sequences** that convert leads into customers

copy.tagline: 用直复营销原则写出能立即带来转化的销售文案。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让文案直接带来可衡量的销售转化。
